prova:
have h_irrational : Irrational (erdos_252_sum k) := by
  have h1 : Irrational (erdos_252_sum 0) := by
    exact Erdos252.erdos_252.variants.k_eq_zero
  have h2 : Irrational (erdos_252_sum 1) := by
    exact Erdos252.erdos_252.variants.k_eq_one
  have h3 : Irrational (erdos_252_sum 2) := by
    exact Erdos252.erdos_252.variants.k_eq_two
  have h4 : Irrational (erdos_252_sum 3) := by
    exact Erdos252.erdos_252.variants.k_eq_three
  have h5 : Irrational (erdos_252_sum 4) := by
    exact Erdos252.erdos_252.variants.k_eq_four
  rcases k with (rfl | k)
  · exact h1
  · rcases k with (rfl | k)
    · exact h2
    · rcases k with (rfl | k)
      · exact h3
      · rcases k with (rfl | k)
        · exact h4
        · exact h5
exact h_irrational
